items.text:
I gave my Grok @bot one job: find my dad’s Costco receipt. 

Now Dad can basically Google his entire Costco purchase history. 😭  

Our ice maker broke, and he was opening receipts on Costco's site one PDF at a time just to figure out when we bought it.  

So I put my bot Señor Inteligente on it. It logged in, found the receipt, and built a searchable database that updates with new receipts every week.

It can even find sales on stuff he’s bought before! @elonmusk @poteto @mattyp

items.author: PipeSalazar
items.text:
I made Grok Bot our full-time travel assistant for a week-long family road trip. It felt like having someone else working for us while we took care of the kids and enjoyed the trip.

Munich → Nancy → Reims → Disneyland Paris → Paris → Colmar → home, in our Tesla. Two adults, an 8-year-old, and a baby about to turn one.

I'll skip the trip diary. Here's what the bot actually handled.

Planning around my wife
My wife had never been to Paris, so the bot built the week around her: a must-see Paris day, plus two Disney days for the kids. Everything lived on one live day-by-day page with the route map, Supercharger stops, a to-do list and official links. It emailed her a summary in Spanish. She replied the same day: looks great, don't change a thing.

Where we slept
For our two overnight stops, it sent her a shortlist in Spanish: 4 options per city, Airbnbs included, with prices, ratings, cancellation terms and nearby Superchargers. She booked straight from that list. Both places were great.

Grok in the car knew the plan
Grok in my Tesla could reach everything Grok Bot had planned, so I had the whole trip with me in the driver's seat.

Nancy, after 10 p.m.
This is the moment that got me. Weeks earlier, the bot had emailed the hotel in French and learned two things: reception closes at 21:00, and late arrivals have to call the night staff from the gate.

We rolled in after 10 p.m. and the gate was shut. Grok Bot handed the number to Grok in the car, which called right away.

I never touched my phone 🤯

Fighter jets over the Supercharger
While we were charging in Saint-Dizier, dozens of fighter jets roared over us at very low altitude. It was loud enough that my daughter got scared, and we had no idea what was going on. So we asked Grok in the car. It told us we were right next to one of France's most important air bases and that the jets were most likely Rafales on a routine exercise. Then it gave us a little lecture on the Rafale and fighter jets in general. The scary moment ended up as a lesson for the whole car.

Lunch in Reims
It searched the Michelin Guide for a good restaurant on our route and under our budget, and found Brasserie Le Jardin in Reims. Then it made the reservation itself, in French, added a high chair for the baby and moved us from 12:30 to 13:30. When we were still running late on the road, it told them we'd arrive around 14:00.

Disney
It researched the best place to watch the closing show and found us the perfect spot.

A new plan for Paris
We changed plans on Paris day, so the bot rebuilt it around an afternoon and evening: a garage at Porte Maillot, the metro to the Louvre and the Tuileries, Notre-Dame, the Champs-Élysées, then Trocadéro for sunset and the Eiffel Tower sparkle. It emailed my wife the new plan in Spanish, with walking maps.

Colmar in the rain
Driving to Colmar in the rain, we were going to miss reception. The bot fixed our booking and arranged a key-safe check-in.

The next morning it rebuilt the day:
• the best parking
• the little green train instead of the boat (grey day + baby)
• the toy museum
• a brunch spot with specialty coffee
• a self-guided Little Venice walk with a Google Maps route

My inbox
It checked my email every morning and evening and only pinged me when something needed a decision. It flagged important receipts and deadlines and left the rest alone.

Spanish for my wife
My wife and I plan in Spanish, so the bot wrote to her in Spanish and answered her questions about parking and checkout.

People here show Grok Bot automating their work. I used it to carry the logistics of a family trip, so we could spend the week with the kids and with each other.

items.author: boydmyers
items.text:
Some of you all know I worked in home sales for the better part of a decade.

Got bored last night, had a quick brainstorming session with my Grok Bot, and built Mortgage Unpacked.  

It's a free mortgage resource that has everything mortgage related I could think of, and teaches potential homeowners to look at their situation like an underwriter, breaks down the different types of loans, the steps of mortgage, etc.

I probably should've recorded it, because it literally was as basic as it could be, and I didn't touch one line of code.  

Actually, I never left the Grok Bot app.

I told me Chief of Staff (Ares - Master Control, I'm a massive Tron nerd) what I wanted to do.  Started throwing all the material I wanted to cover and asked him if there was anything obvious that I was missing and he made some recommendations.

Had him create a new bot responsible for the site, Fannie - Mortgage Site Boss.

She did the research, started the build, and sent me her first draft.  It was absolutely horrible, so I told her to clean it up and after a few iterations, I was happy enough.

They're already connected to my domain registrar, so I brainstormed a few name ideas with Ares, settled on one I liked, told him to go buy it and have Fannie push it live.

Once it was live, I found a few things I left out, sent it back to Ares (who sent it to Fannie), told him once she makes the changes and tests it, push it live.  

It's not that elaborate of a site - it dynamically pulls rates - but lots of information and I thought it'd make a great resource for anyone thinking about real estate, realtors, etc.  

All in, under 90 minutes (would've been way faster but I was doing a few other things).

I'm going to do all of this from scratch on a video - should have time tomorrow.

If you want to check it out (whether you're thinking about a morgage or just curious to see what my bots and I put together), check out the link below.

ms.title: Persediaan Grok Bot pengasas untuk jualan: prospek, pemulihan pelanggan dan makan tengah hari
ms.summary: Penulis membina bot yang membantu pasukan jualan menyusun keutamaan prospek, memujuk pelanggan yang hendak meninggalkan platform, menghubungi bakal pelanggan pada masa sesuai, malah memesan makan tengah hari pejabat, dan menerangkan cara dia menggunakannya sebagai pengasas.

vi.title: Nhà sáng lập dùng Grok Bot cho bán hàng: lọc khách tiềm năng, giữ khách, đặt cơm trưa
vi.summary: Tác giả xây các bot giúp đội bán hàng ưu tiên khách tiềm năng, giữ chân khách sắp rời nền tảng, liên hệ khách đúng lúc và cả đặt cơm trưa cho văn phòng, rồi chia sẻ trong một chuỗi bài cách cô dùng nó với vai trò nhà sáng lập.

fr.title: Une fondatrice et ses bots Grok Bot pour la vente : leads, reconquête, déjeuner

es.title: Una fundadora usa Grok Bot en ventas: leads, recuperar clientes y pedir comida
es.summary: La autora creó bots que ayudan al equipo de ventas a priorizar leads, recuperar clientes que dejan la plataforma, contactar prospectos en el momento justo e incluso pedir el almuerzo de la oficina, y explica en un hilo cómo lo usa como fundadora.

de.title: Gründerin nutzt Grok Bot im Vertrieb: Leads, Rückgewinnung, Mittagessen
de.summary: Die Autorin baute Bots, die dem Vertrieb helfen, Leads zu priorisieren, abwandernde Kunden zurückzugewinnen, Interessenten zum richtigen Zeitpunkt anzusprechen und sogar das Büromittagessen zu bestellen; im Thread erklärt sie ihre Nutzung als Gründerin.

zh-TW.title: 第一次用 Grok Bot 打電話：替鈑金店排名並逐一致電
zh-TW.summary: 作者首次使用電話功能：Grok Bot 依評價和 BBB 替本地鈑金店排名，選出三家高分店，逐一打電話（每通都錄音）詢問細節、做了大量筆記並安排預約。

en.title: First phone-call run with Grok Bot: ranking and calling body shops

ko.title: Grok Bot 전화 기능 첫 사용: 차체 정비소 순위 매기고 전화

ms.title: Kali pertama guna panggilan telefon Grok Bot: menilai dan menelefon bengkel badan kereta
ms.summary: Penulis menggunakan ciri panggilan buat kali pertama: Grok Bot menyusun bengkel badan kereta tempatan berdasarkan ulasan dan BBB, memilih tiga yang dinilai tinggi, menelefon setiap satu (semua panggilan dirakam) dengan soalan terperinci, mencatat nota dan membuat jadual.

vi.title: Lần đầu dùng tính năng gọi điện của Grok Bot: xếp hạng và gọi tiệm sửa thân xe
vi.summary: Tác giả lần đầu dùng tính năng gọi điện: Grok Bot xếp hạng các tiệm sửa thân xe gần nhà theo đánh giá và BBB, chọn ba tiệm điểm cao, gọi từng tiệm (ghi âm mọi cuộc gọi) để hỏi chi tiết, ghi chép kỹ và lên lịch hẹn.

es.title: Primera llamada con Grok Bot: clasificar y llamar a talleres de chapa
es.summary: Al probar por primera vez la función de llamadas, Grok Bot clasificó los talleres de chapa locales por reseñas y el BBB, eligió tres bien valorados, llamó a cada uno (grabando todas las llamadas) con preguntas detalladas, tomó muchas notas y agendó.

es.summary: El autor activó Mensajes para Grok Bot y en el Mac habilitó Grok Bot en Ajustes del Sistema, Privacidad y seguridad, Acceso total al disco. Después pudo leer los mensajes existentes y cuatro cenas se convirtieron en una lista de la compra de 28 artículos.

ms.title: Mencetuskan rutin Grok Bot daripada iPhone Shortcuts

vi.title: Kích hoạt routine Grok Bot bằng iPhone Shortcuts
vi.summary: Một tự động hóa iPhone Shortcuts khởi chạy routine của Grok Bot khi có iMessage chứa từ khóa từ một người gửi, và chuyển nội dung tin nhắn vào. Không cần mở ứng dụng: routine chỉ cần webhook trigger, và cách này dùng được với mọi ứng dụng gửi được yêu cầu POST.

GrokBot users are burning 43% of their weekly limit on f*cking nothing. Routines waking up to empty inboxes, GrokBots rereading months of chat - released 12-page PDF

it shows where usage goes and how to stop it in 10 steps

Step 1 → Map the pool
Grok chat, Imagine and Cursor drain the same weekly limit. Start a new chat per topic.

Step 2 → Audit before you cut
Ask your Bot to list every routine, how often it runs and what it found. Change nothing yet.

Step 3 → Slow the schedules
A routine every 15 min = 672 runs a week. Hourly max, weekdays, work hours only.

Step 4 → Wake on events, not the clock
Swap polling for triggers: Slack mention, GitHub, email, webhook. 672 runs → ~15.

Step 5 → Start fresh
A Bot in a 6-week-old thread rereads all of it before every reply. Handoff note + Duplicate.

Step 6 → Put the profile on a diet
One screen of rules. Delete memories nobody uses. One job per Bot.

Step 7 → Give every task a finish line
Scope, "done when", "stop if it fails twice", word cap. No more retry loops.

Step 8 → Apps over clicks
Every screenshot is tokens. Connect the app and save repeat jobs as skills.

Step 9 → One owner per job
4 Bots in a group = 4 billed replies to one question. Only the owner answers.

Step 10 → Pace the week
Wednesday check: under 43%. At 80%, low-usage mode. Set a spend cap.

Your AI employee just got a second desk.

OpenAI's dots can now connect to multiple local computers. One dot, several machines — you pick which one runs each task. Build and test your app on the spare box while you keep coding on your laptop.

Until yesterday, a dot got one machine. That was the bottleneck: the always-on agent in the cloud had exactly one foothold on your desk, and every local job queued through it.

And it's still Pro and up. Free and Plus don't get dots at all.

Here's the catch. Each thread still runs on one computer at a time, and there are no per-machine permissions. One "Allow access" hands the dot that machine's files, code, and apps — all of it, not the folder you meant.

So the upgrade is real, and so is the trade. The dot that builds on your spare machine is the same dot that can read everything on it.

The multi-computer update isn't about more computers. It's about how much of your desk you're willing to hand over.

de.title: Dots auf mehreren Rechnern: ein zweiter Schreibtisch, mehr Zugriff
de.summary: OpenAI dots kann sich jetzt mit mehreren lokalen Rechnern verbinden; pro Aufgabe wählst du einen, etwa Build und Tests auf einem Zweitgerät, während du am Laptop weiterprogrammierst. Weiterhin nur ab Pro. Der Haken: Jeder Thread läuft auf einem Rechner zur Zeit, und es gibt keine Rechte pro Gerät – ein „Zugriff erlauben“ gibt alle Dateien, Code und Apps dieses Rechners frei.

items.author: MookandMush
items.text: Bad day with chatgpt dots wasted %60 of the weeks compute working in on chat despite clear instructions to distribute the work.   Failing to see how dot is useful if it keeps making calls like that.   Thinkng about canceling again with how good grok bots are.

zh-CN.title: ChatGPT Dots 一天耗掉一周 60% 算力
zh-CN.summary: 作者明确要求分配工作，但 ChatGPT Dots 仍在对话里自己干活，浪费了一周 60% 的算力。作者质疑这样的决策是否有用，并考虑再次取消订阅。

zh-TW.title: ChatGPT Dots 一天耗掉一週 60% 算力
zh-TW.summary: 作者明確要求分配工作，但 ChatGPT Dots 仍在對話裡自己做，浪費了一週 60% 的算力。作者質疑這樣的決策是否有用，並考慮再次取消訂閱。

en.title: ChatGPT Dots burns 60% of a week’s compute in one day
en.summary: Despite clear instructions to distribute the work, ChatGPT Dots did it inside the chat and wasted 60% of the week’s compute. The author questions its usefulness if it keeps making calls like that and is thinking about canceling again.

ja.title: ChatGPT Dots が1日で週の計算量の60%を消費
ja.summary: 作業を分散するよう明確に指示したのに、ChatGPT Dots はチャット内で自分で処理し、週の計算量の60%を無駄にした。投稿者はこうした判断が続くなら役に立つのか疑問だとし、再度の解約を考えている。

ko.title: ChatGPT Dots, 하루 만에 주간 연산량 60% 소진
ko.summary: 작업을 나누라고 분명히 지시했는데도 ChatGPT Dots는 채팅 안에서 직접 처리해 주간 연산량의 60%를 낭비했다. 작성자는 이런 판단이 계속된다면 쓸모가 있는지 의문이라며 다시 해지를 고민 중이다.

ms.title: ChatGPT Dots habiskan 60% kuota mingguan dalam sehari
ms.summary: Walaupun diarah dengan jelas supaya mengagihkan kerja, ChatGPT Dots melakukannya dalam sembang dan membazirkan 60% kuota pengiraan seminggu. Penulis mempersoalkan kegunaannya jika terus membuat keputusan begitu dan mempertimbangkan untuk membatalkan lagi.

vi.title: ChatGPT Dots tiêu 60% sức tính toán cả tuần trong một ngày
vi.summary: Dù đã dặn rõ phải phân chia công việc, ChatGPT Dots vẫn tự làm trong khung chat và lãng phí 60% sức tính toán của tuần. Tác giả nghi ngờ tính hữu ích nếu nó cứ quyết định như vậy và đang nghĩ đến chuyện hủy gói lần nữa.

fr.title: ChatGPT Dots consomme 60 % du quota de la semaine en un jour
fr.summary: Malgré des consignes claires pour répartir le travail, ChatGPT Dots l’a fait dans la conversation et a gaspillé 60 % du calcul de la semaine. L’auteur doute de son utilité s’il continue ainsi et envisage de résilier à nouveau.

es.title: ChatGPT Dots gasta el 60 % del cómputo semanal en un día
es.summary: Pese a instrucciones claras de repartir el trabajo, ChatGPT Dots lo hizo dentro del chat y desperdició el 60 % del cómputo de la semana. El autor duda de su utilidad si sigue decidiendo así y piensa en cancelar otra vez.

de.title: ChatGPT Dots verbraucht an einem Tag 60 % des Wochenkontingents
de.summary: Trotz klarer Anweisung, die Arbeit zu verteilen, erledigte ChatGPT Dots sie im Chat und verschwendete 60 % der Wochenrechenzeit. Der Autor zweifelt am Nutzen, wenn es so weiterentscheidet, und erwägt erneut zu kündigen.

zh-CN.title: Dots 的简单自动化一天坏 5 次
zh-CN.summary: 作者给了 dot 完全授权、让它主动修复，但简单的自动化仍一天坏 5 次。作者往往 12 到 48 小时后才发现，而 dot 的回复是“我告诉过你了”，那句提醒夹在 8 条无关要点中间。

zh-TW.title: Dots 的簡單自動化一天壞 5 次
zh-TW.summary: 作者給了 dot 完全授權、讓它主動修復，但簡單的自動化仍一天壞 5 次。作者常在 12 到 48 小時後才發現，而 dot 的回覆是「我告訴過你了」，那句提醒夾在 8 條無關重點中間。

en.title: Simple Dots automations break five times a day
en.summary: The author gave the dot full authority and permission to fix things proactively, yet simple automations break five times a day. He notices 12 to 48 hours later, and the dot replies that it told him, in the middle of eight unrelated bullet points.

ja.title: Dots の簡単な自動化が1日5回壊れる
ja.summary: 投稿者は dot に全権限と自発的に直す許可を与えたが、簡単な自動化が1日5回壊れる。気づくのは12〜48時間後で、dot は「伝えました」と答えるが、その知らせは無関係な8つの箇条書きの中に埋もれていた。

ko.title: Dots의 간단한 자동화가 하루 5번 고장
ko.summary: 작성자는 dot에게 전권과 선제적으로 고칠 권한을 줬지만 간단한 자동화가 하루 5번씩 고장 난다. 12~48시간 뒤에야 알아채는데, dot은 이미 말했다고 답한다. 그 알림은 관련 없는 항목 8개 사이에 묻혀 있었다.

ms.title: Automasi ringkas Dots rosak lima kali sehari
ms.summary: Penulis memberi dot kuasa penuh dan kebenaran untuk membaiki secara proaktif, namun automasi ringkas rosak lima kali sehari. Dia hanya perasan 12 hingga 48 jam kemudian, dan dot menjawab ia sudah memberitahu, di tengah lapan poin yang tidak berkaitan.

vi.title: Tự động hóa đơn giản của Dots hỏng 5 lần mỗi ngày
vi.summary: Tác giả đã trao cho dot toàn quyền và cho phép chủ động sửa lỗi, nhưng các tự động hóa đơn giản vẫn hỏng 5 lần mỗi ngày. Anh chỉ phát hiện sau 12 đến 48 giờ, và dot đáp rằng nó đã báo, nằm giữa 8 gạch đầu dòng không liên quan.

fr.title: Des automatisations simples de Dots cassent cinq fois par jour
fr.summary: L’auteur a donné à son dot les pleins pouvoirs et l’autorisation de corriger de lui-même, mais de simples automatisations cassent cinq fois par jour. Il s’en rend compte 12 à 48 heures plus tard, et le dot répond qu’il l’avait signalé, au milieu de huit points sans rapport.

es.title: Automatizaciones simples de Dots fallan cinco veces al día
es.summary: El autor dio a su dot plena autoridad y permiso para arreglar cosas por iniciativa propia, pero automatizaciones sencillas fallan cinco veces al día. Lo nota entre 12 y 48 horas después, y el dot responde que ya se lo dijo, en medio de ocho puntos sin relación.

de.title: Einfache Dots-Automationen brechen fünfmal am Tag
de.summary: Der Autor gab seinem dot volle Befugnis und die Erlaubnis, proaktiv zu reparieren, doch einfache Automationen brechen fünfmal täglich. Er merkt es 12 bis 48 Stunden später, und der dot antwortet, er habe es gesagt – mitten in acht themenfremden Stichpunkten.

items.author: houseperu
items.text:
I’ve been working with Grok Bot for several weeks and have recently detected serious flaws. 

It has major memory problems and gets confused with simple instructions, even though it handles complex operations well. 

I’ve put real effort into building a robust memory system with dedicated folders for each bot, and the result is still mediocre. 

Processing is low. Today has been especially bad. We’re building a relatively simple application and it repeats mistakes over and over.

The worst part is that when the application is already working correctly and only detail adjustments remain, correcting them destroys all the previous work. It does this constantly. The errors are unacceptable. 

Grok Bot is astonishingly powerful, but these failures cannot be tolerated. They should improve the memory system. My bots have very specific instructions and they break them repeatedly.

This is not an isolated glitch. It is the consequence of a design that prioritizes impressing in demos over being reliable in daily use. 

The external memory system I built is a patch on top of another patch. 

The problem is not in my folders, but in how the model weighs what it reads against what it internally assumes it already knows. 

That is why it breaks concrete instructions: it is not that it does not understand them, it is that it subordinates them to an internal assumption I cannot audit. https://t.co/V2LuHDig19

zh-CN.title: 用了几周 Grok Bot：记忆问题让细节修改毁掉成果
zh-CN.summary: 作者用 Grok Bot 数周，认为它能处理复杂操作，却在简单指令上反复出错。即便为每个 bot 建了专门的记忆文件夹，效果仍一般；做一个相对简单的应用时，它反复犯同样的错，在只剩细节调整时一改就破坏之前的工作。作者认为问题在于模型把内部假设置于明确指令之上。

zh-TW.title: 用了幾週 Grok Bot：記憶問題讓細節修改毀掉成果
zh-TW.summary: 作者用 Grok Bot 數週，認為它能處理複雜操作，卻在簡單指令上反覆出錯。即使替每個 bot 建了專屬的記憶資料夾，效果仍普通；做一個相對簡單的應用時，它反覆犯同樣的錯，在只剩細節調整時一改就破壞先前的工作。作者認為問題在於模型把內部假設置於明確指令之上。

en.title: Weeks with Grok Bot: memory problems undo finished work
en.summary: After several weeks, the author finds Grok Bot handles complex operations but stumbles on simple instructions. Even with a dedicated memory folder per bot, results stay mediocre; on a fairly simple app it repeats mistakes, and detail fixes on working code destroy earlier work. He argues the model puts its internal assumptions above explicit instructions.

ja.title: Grok Bot を数週間使って：記憶の問題で細部の修正が成果を壊す
ja.summary: 投稿者は数週間使い、Grok Bot は複雑な操作はこなすが簡単な指示で迷うと感じている。bot ごとに専用の記憶フォルダを作っても結果は平凡。比較的簡単なアプリ作りで同じ誤りを繰り返し、動いている状態で細部を直すと以前の作業を壊す。モデルが明示的な指示より内部の思い込みを優先していると指摘する。

ko.title: Grok Bot 몇 주 사용기: 기억 문제로 세부 수정이 결과물을 망쳐
ko.summary: 작성자는 몇 주간 써 보니 Grok Bot이 복잡한 작업은 잘하지만 간단한 지시에서 헷갈린다고 말한다. bot마다 전용 기억 폴더를 만들어도 결과는 평범했고, 비교적 간단한 앱을 만들며 같은 실수를 반복하고, 잘 돌아가는 상태에서 세부를 고치면 이전 작업을 망가뜨렸다. 모델이 명시적 지시보다 내부 가정을 우선한다고 본다.

ms.title: Beberapa minggu dengan Grok Bot: masalah ingatan rosakkan kerja siap
ms.summary: Selepas beberapa minggu, penulis dapati Grok Bot boleh mengendalikan operasi kompleks tetapi keliru dengan arahan mudah. Walaupun ada folder ingatan khusus untuk setiap bot, hasilnya biasa sahaja; semasa membina aplikasi agak mudah ia mengulangi kesilapan, dan pembetulan butiran pada kod yang sudah berfungsi merosakkan kerja terdahulu. Dia berpendapat model mengutamakan andaian dalamannya berbanding arahan jelas.

vi.title: Vài tuần với Grok Bot: lỗi trí nhớ làm hỏng phần đã xong
vi.summary: Sau vài tuần, tác giả thấy Grok Bot xử lý tốt thao tác phức tạp nhưng lại rối với chỉ dẫn đơn giản. Dù đã làm thư mục bộ nhớ riêng cho từng bot, kết quả vẫn tầm thường; khi làm một ứng dụng khá đơn giản nó lặp lại lỗi, và sửa chi tiết trên bản đang chạy thì phá hỏng công việc trước đó. Anh cho rằng mô hình đặt giả định nội bộ lên trên chỉ dẫn rõ ràng.

fr.title: Quelques semaines avec Grok Bot : la mémoire défait le travail fini
fr.summary: Après plusieurs semaines, l’auteur constate que Grok Bot gère des opérations complexes mais trébuche sur des consignes simples. Même avec un dossier de mémoire dédié par bot, le résultat reste médiocre ; sur une application assez simple, il répète ses erreurs, et de petites retouches sur un code qui fonctionne détruisent le travail précédent. Selon lui, le modèle fait passer ses suppositions internes avant les consignes explicites.

es.title: Semanas con Grok Bot: problemas de memoria deshacen el trabajo hecho
es.summary: Tras varias semanas, el autor ve que Grok Bot maneja operaciones complejas pero se confunde con instrucciones simples. Aun con una carpeta de memoria dedicada por bot, el resultado es mediocre; en una aplicación bastante sencilla repite errores, y los ajustes de detalle sobre código que ya funciona destruyen el trabajo previo. Sostiene que el modelo antepone sus supuestos internos a las instrucciones explícitas.

de.title: Wochen mit Grok Bot: Gedächtnisprobleme machen fertige Arbeit kaputt
de.summary: Nach einigen Wochen stellt der Autor fest, dass Grok Bot komplexe Abläufe schafft, aber an einfachen Anweisungen scheitert. Trotz eigener Gedächtnisordner pro Bot bleibt das Ergebnis mittelmäßig; bei einer recht einfachen App wiederholt er Fehler, und Detailkorrekturen an funktionierendem Code zerstören frühere Arbeit. Er meint, das Modell stelle interne Annahmen über klare Anweisungen.

items.author: arnoldgamboa
items.text:
Grok Bot is replaceable.

I say that as someone who runs a lot of my days on it.

I'm moving my bots over to OpenBot one by one and testing both side by side every day. So far, my daily routine carries over. Honestly, it could carry over to almost any AI agent.

What I'll miss is real: the big team behind Grok Bot, and how constantly it keeps improving. That can be rebuilt, but only slowly.

The bigger difference turned out to be the model.

A model I pay for on my own subscription is one I can use however I want, without the anxiety of losing my daily routines.

The platform matters less than I thought. The model I choose matters more.

If the tool running your routines disappeared tomorrow, what would you still own?

zh-CN.title: Grok Bot 可以被替代：平台不如模型重要
zh-CN.summary: 作者把很多日常交给 Grok Bot，现在正把 bot 一个个迁到 OpenBot，每天并行对比。到目前为止日常流程都能迁过去。他会怀念 Grok Bot 背后的大团队和持续改进，但发现更大的差异在模型：用自己订阅的模型，不必担心失去日常例程。

zh-TW.title: Grok Bot 可以被取代：平台不如模型重要
zh-TW.summary: 作者把很多日常交給 Grok Bot，現在正把 bot 一個個遷到 OpenBot，每天並行比較。到目前為止日常流程都能搬過去。他會懷念 Grok Bot 背後的大團隊和持續改進，但發現更大的差異在模型：用自己訂閱的模型，不必擔心失去日常例行任務。

en.title: Grok Bot is replaceable: the model matters more than the platform
en.summary: The author runs much of his day on Grok Bot but is moving bots to OpenBot one by one, testing both side by side daily. So far his routine carries over. He will miss Grok Bot’s big team and steady improvements, but finds the bigger difference is the model: one he pays for on his own subscription can be used freely without fear of losing his routines.

ja.title: Grok Bot は置き換え可能：プラットフォームよりモデルが重要
ja.summary: 投稿者は日々の多くを Grok Bot で回しているが、bot を一つずつ OpenBot へ移し、毎日並行して比較中。今のところ日課はそのまま移せている。Grok Bot の大きなチームと継続的な改善は惜しいが、より大きな違いはモデルだと気づいた。自分のサブスクで払うモデルなら、日課を失う不安なく自由に使える。

ko.title: Grok Bot은 대체 가능하다: 플랫폼보다 모델이 중요
ko.summary: 작성자는 하루의 많은 부분을 Grok Bot으로 돌리지만 bot을 하나씩 OpenBot으로 옮기며 매일 나란히 비교 중이다. 지금까지 일상 루틴은 그대로 옮겨졌다. Grok Bot의 큰 팀과 꾸준한 개선은 아쉽겠지만, 더 큰 차이는 모델이었다. 자기 구독으로 쓰는 모델은 루틴을 잃을 걱정 없이 자유롭게 쓸 수 있다.

ms.title: Grok Bot boleh diganti: model lebih penting daripada platform
ms.summary: Penulis menjalankan banyak urusan harian dengan Grok Bot tetapi sedang memindahkan bot satu demi satu ke OpenBot sambil menguji kedua-duanya setiap hari. Setakat ini rutinnya boleh dipindahkan. Dia akan merindui pasukan besar dan penambahbaikan berterusan Grok Bot, namun perbezaan lebih besar ialah model: model yang dibayar dengan langganan sendiri boleh digunakan bebas tanpa risau kehilangan rutin.

vi.title: Grok Bot có thể thay thế: mô hình quan trọng hơn nền tảng
vi.summary: Tác giả dùng Grok Bot cho phần lớn công việc hằng ngày nhưng đang chuyển từng bot sang OpenBot và so sánh song song mỗi ngày. Đến nay quy trình hằng ngày vẫn chuyển được. Anh sẽ nhớ đội ngũ lớn và việc cải tiến liên tục của Grok Bot, nhưng khác biệt lớn hơn là mô hình: mô hình tự trả bằng gói riêng thì dùng thoải mái, không lo mất routine.

fr.title: Grok Bot est remplaçable : le modèle compte plus que la plateforme
fr.summary: L’auteur fait tourner une grande partie de ses journées sur Grok Bot mais migre ses bots un par un vers OpenBot, en testant les deux chaque jour. Jusqu’ici, sa routine suit. Il regrettera la grande équipe derrière Grok Bot et ses améliorations constantes, mais la vraie différence tient au modèle : celui qu’il paie avec son propre abonnement s’utilise librement, sans craindre de perdre ses routines.

es.title: Grok Bot es reemplazable: importa más el modelo que la plataforma
es.summary: El autor lleva gran parte de su día en Grok Bot, pero está pasando sus bots uno a uno a OpenBot y prueba ambos a diario. Hasta ahora su rutina se traslada. Echará de menos el gran equipo detrás de Grok Bot y su mejora constante, pero la diferencia mayor es el modelo: uno que paga con su propia suscripción puede usarlo libremente sin miedo a perder sus rutinas.

de.title: Grok Bot ist ersetzbar: Das Modell zählt mehr als die Plattform
de.summary: Der Autor erledigt viel seines Tages mit Grok Bot, zieht seine Bots aber einzeln zu OpenBot um und testet beide täglich parallel. Bisher lässt sich seine Routine übertragen. Das große Team hinter Grok Bot und die ständigen Verbesserungen wird er vermissen, doch der größere Unterschied ist das Modell: Eines, das er über sein eigenes Abo bezahlt, kann er frei nutzen, ohne Angst um seine Routinen.

items.author: thomasheimann
items.text:
I do not pick agents with a bake-off.

I pick the one job that is boring, frequent, and easy to check. I give it one owner. I run it in draft until the definition of done holds for a clean stretch.

OpenClaw, Hermes, Grok Bot — I run all three in my companies. The platform only matters after the job, the owner, and the review path are clear.

Tool bake-offs are fun for builders. Founders need a first workflow that survives contact with a customer.

zh-CN.title: 选代理别搞横评：先挑一件无聊、频繁、易检查的事
zh-CN.summary: 作者在公司同时用 OpenClaw、Hermes 和 Grok Bot。他不靠横评选工具，而是先挑一件无聊、频繁、容易核对的工作，指定一个负责人，以草稿模式运行，直到“完成标准”连续稳定达标。工作、负责人和审核路径清楚之后，平台才重要。

zh-TW.title: 選代理別搞橫評：先挑一件無聊、頻繁、易檢查的事
zh-TW.summary: 作者在公司同時用 OpenClaw、Hermes 和 Grok Bot。他不靠橫評選工具，而是先挑一件無聊、頻繁、容易核對的工作，指定一位負責人，以草稿模式執行，直到「完成標準」連續穩定達標。工作、負責人和審核路徑清楚之後，平台才重要。

en.title: Pick agents by job, not by bake-off
en.summary: The author runs OpenClaw, Hermes and Grok Bot in his companies. Instead of a bake-off he picks one boring, frequent, easy-to-check job, gives it one owner, and runs it in draft until the definition of done holds for a clean stretch. The platform only matters once the job, owner and review path are clear.

ja.title: エージェントは比較ではなく仕事で選ぶ
ja.summary: 投稿者は自社で OpenClaw、Hermes、Grok Bot を併用。ツール比較で選ぶのではなく、退屈で頻繁、確認しやすい仕事を一つ選び、担当者を一人決め、完了の定義が安定して満たされるまで下書きモードで動かす。仕事、担当、レビュー経路が明確になって初めてプラットフォームが意味を持つ。

ko.title: 에이전트는 비교 테스트가 아니라 일로 고른다
ko.summary: 작성자는 회사에서 OpenClaw, Hermes, Grok Bot을 모두 쓴다. 비교 테스트 대신 지루하고 자주 있고 확인하기 쉬운 일 하나를 골라 담당자 한 명을 정하고, 완료 기준이 한동안 깔끔하게 유지될 때까지 초안 모드로 돌린다. 일, 담당자, 검토 경로가 분명해진 뒤에야 플랫폼이 중요해진다.

ms.title: Pilih ejen mengikut kerja, bukan pertandingan alat
ms.summary: Penulis menggunakan OpenClaw, Hermes dan Grok Bot dalam syarikatnya. Daripada membandingkan alat, dia memilih satu kerja yang membosankan, kerap dan mudah disemak, melantik seorang pemilik, dan menjalankannya dalam mod draf sehingga takrif siap kekal stabil untuk satu tempoh. Platform hanya penting selepas kerja, pemilik dan laluan semakan jelas.

vi.title: Chọn agent theo công việc, không phải thi so tài
vi.summary: Tác giả dùng cả OpenClaw, Hermes và Grok Bot trong các công ty của mình. Thay vì so tài công cụ, anh chọn một việc nhàm chán, thường xuyên, dễ kiểm tra, giao cho một người phụ trách và chạy ở chế độ nháp đến khi tiêu chí hoàn thành ổn định một thời gian. Nền tảng chỉ quan trọng sau khi việc, người phụ trách và quy trình duyệt đã rõ.

fr.title: Choisir un agent par la tâche, pas par un comparatif
fr.summary: L’auteur utilise OpenClaw, Hermes et Grok Bot dans ses entreprises. Plutôt qu’un comparatif, il choisit une tâche ennuyeuse, fréquente et facile à vérifier, lui donne un responsable et la fait tourner en brouillon jusqu’à ce que la définition de « terminé » tienne sur une bonne période. La plateforme ne compte qu’une fois la tâche, le responsable et la relecture clarifiés.

es.title: Elegir agente por el trabajo, no por una comparativa
es.summary: El autor usa OpenClaw, Hermes y Grok Bot en sus empresas. En lugar de comparar herramientas, elige un trabajo aburrido, frecuente y fácil de comprobar, le asigna un responsable y lo ejecuta en modo borrador hasta que la definición de terminado se cumple de forma estable. La plataforma solo importa cuando el trabajo, el responsable y la revisión están claros.

de.title: Agenten nach Aufgabe wählen, nicht per Vergleichstest
de.summary: Der Autor nutzt OpenClaw, Hermes und Grok Bot in seinen Firmen. Statt eines Vergleichstests wählt er eine langweilige, häufige, leicht prüfbare Aufgabe, gibt ihr einen Verantwortlichen und lässt sie im Entwurfsmodus laufen, bis die Definition von „fertig“ eine Weile stabil hält. Die Plattform zählt erst, wenn Aufgabe, Verantwortlicher und Prüfweg klar sind.

es.title: Una sola persona con todo un cuerpo técnico en Meta Muse

de.title: Eine Person, ein ganzer Trainerstab auf Meta Muse
de.summary: Der Autor baute mit Meta Muse einen „Trainerstab“, der rund um die Uhr auf Rechnern bei ihm zu Hause läuft: Stabschef, Ingenieur, Scout, Buchhalter, Terminplaner und über zwanzig weitere Rollen. Teil 3 seiner Reihe Using AI Assistants.
